senses.gloss: m. (נָשַׁק, cmp. אינשתם, fr. נְשַׁם) attachment, a contrivance to prevent the handle of a coal-pan from getting too hot.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 3">Tosef. Yoma III (II), 3</cite> <he>בכל יום לא היה לה נ׳</he> on any other day the priest’s coal-pan had no damper &c.; <cite ref="Yoma 44b:16">Yoma 44ᵇ</cite> <he>נִיאַשְׁתֵּיק</he> (Ms. M. <he>נִיאוּשְׁ׳</he>; Rashi: ‘a rattling ring’); Y. ib. IV, 41ᵈ top <cite ref="N01276"><he>נרתיק</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:5">Koh. R. to I, 5</cite> [read:] <he>מערטלו מִנַּשְׁתֵּקוֹ</he> or <he>מִנַּרְתֵּקוֹ</he> (v. <cite ref="E00944"><he>השתק</he></cite>).
